name: Rusinkiewicz Coordinate BRDF Evaluation
definition: Evaluates a learned BRDF by transforming view and light directions into a local coordinate frame aligned with the surface normal, converting them to Rusinkiewicz coordinates, and querying a neural network.
summary: Rusinkiewicz Coordinate BRDF Evaluation transforms directions into a local frame to exploit geometric symmetry, reducing input dimensionality and improving sampling efficiency for neural BRDF queries.
